none: PAS SWYOR-EB53C6: A Roman coin: a nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Doncaster (Inghilterra e Galles)

A damaged Roman coin: a copper alloy nummus of the House of Constantine dating from AD321 (Reece period 16), the reverse legend BEATA TRANQVILLITAS. The reverse depicts a globe on an altar inscribed VOT/IS/XX in three lines. Three stars above. The mint is Lyon. The coin is incomplete, having suffered a number of edge chips. It is 15.6mm in diameter and 1.7mm thick. It weighs 0.98gm
